text: Hierarchical code review undermines long-term participation by reviewers at the edges of the reviewer spectrum, because those reviewers either have no access to the code or no standing to help review it.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Code Review DAO (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4734750
abstract: The hierarchical approach to code reviews undermines long-term participation with opinions from the edges of the reviewer spectrum because those reviewers either have no access or are in no position to help review the code.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: hierarchical review processes with entry barriers
